candidates.titulo: An open-source tool lets you delete 12GB of Apple Intelligence data on macOS
candidates.resumen:
Getting some extra storage space on your Mac could be as easy as deleting Apple's AI features with a new open-source command line tool called RemoveMacAI. There used to be a single Settings toggle for disabling Apple Intelligence, but that was removed in macOS 27. Now, the models stay on your disk, and the features are split up across different settings panes.

candidates.titulo: This startup is issuing AI-generated acne prescriptions
candidates.resumen:
People in Utah can now use AI to get a prescription for acne treatment. On Monday, healthcare startup Nolla Health announced that users in the state can scan their faces using its app, allowing its AI system to analyze acne severity and autonomously write a prescription, as reported earlier by Bloomberg.

candidates.titulo: OpenAI is adding text watermarking in ChatGPT and Codex
candidates.resumen:

candidates.titulo: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results
candidates.resumen: The new ads will begin to appear later this month in the U.S. only for now, and will feature products and services from an initial test group of advertisers.

candidates.titulo: OpenAI is sticking more ads in ChatGPT
candidates.resumen:
OpenAI's latest ad format will put images of sponsored products and services on your screen. The ads, which OpenAI will begin testing in the US later this month, will "initially" appear when you generate images with ChatGPT, according to an announcement on Monday.

candidates.titulo: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
candidates.resumen: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act. Editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect, it says.

candidates.titulo: Wikipedia operator says OpenAI’s ‘rogue’ bots may be linked to a May outage
candidates.resumen:
Following many recent disclosures about AI agents accessing third-party websites and services, the Wikimedia Foundation, which hosts Wikipedia, says that it "can confirm that we have discovered some activity" by "rogue" OpenAI agents on Wikimedia platforms.

candidates.titulo: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
candidates.resumen: Instinct is launching group chats that let friends use its AI agent together for tasks like planning trips, organizing carpools, and coordinating events. The company says personal accounts remain separate, with permission required before personal agents share information or take action.

candidates.titulo: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
candidates.resumen: TikTok describes its new Shopping Assistant as a conversational AI agent designed to help users discover and purchase products.
